newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: German naval vessels due in S.Africa in October.
newsitem.headline: German naval vessels due in S.Africa in October.

text.p: Four German naval ships, one carrying part of the Berlin Wall, will visit South Africa for two weeks next month, the German embassy said on Wednesday.
"The visit...highlights a beginning of military relations between our two countries and military cooperation will be discussed," the embassy said in a statement.
A supply ship, tanker and two frigates are expected to berth in Cape Town on October 2 and sail on to the east coast city of Durban on October 7, where they will stay until October 14.
The supply ship Westerwald is carrying a section of the Berlin Wall, which will be unloaded in Cape Town. The embassy gave no details, however.
